title: The Standard Deviation in VICReg Buys a Safety Margin
abstract: arXiv:2610.32630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: VICReg prevents collapse with a hinge on the standard deviation of each embedding dimension, and its authors argue from the gradient that a hinge on the variance would fail. To our knowledge, this claim has not been tested experimentally. We test it in a controlled setting (ResNet-18, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100), changing only the hinge and sweeping its weight $\mu$ over five orders of magnitude. At the default weight ($\mu = 1$), the two hinges reach the same linear-probe accuracy on CIFAR-10 (about 89.5%). Both collapse below a threshold weight, but the standard-deviation hinge's threshold is 35-130$\times$ lower. CIFAR-100 shows a consistent gap. In training, the variance hinge's gradient fades as the feature variance shrinks, while the standard-deviation hinge's does not until that variance is very small. The standard-deviation hinge therefore buys a safety margin: it keeps training at weights far below the point where the variance hinge

translated_title: VICReg 中的标准差提供了安全边际
translated_abstract: VICReg 通过对每个嵌入维度的标准差施加铰链（hinge）惩罚来防止表征坍塌，其作者曾从梯度角度论证，若改用方差作为铰链则会失效。据我们所知，这一论断尚未经过实验验证。我们在受控环境中（ResNet-18，CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100）对此进行了测试，仅改变铰链项，并将其权重 $\mu$ 在五个数量级范围内进行扫描。在默认权重（$\mu = 1$）下，两种铰链在 CIFAR-10 上达到相同的线性探针准确率（约 89.5%）。当权重低于某个阈值时两者都会坍塌，但标准差铰链的坍塌阈值低了 35-130 倍。CIFAR-100 上也显示出一致的差距。在训练过程中，方差铰链的梯度会随着特征方差的缩小而衰减，而标准差铰链的梯度直到方差非常小时才会衰减。因此，标准差铰链提供了安全边际：它能在远低于方差铰链失效点的权重下仍维持有效训练。
tldr: 本文首次通过实验验证了 VICReg 采用标准差而非方差作为防坍塌正则项的合理性——标准差铰链因其梯度在特征方差缩小时不会过早消失，其坍塌阈值比方差铰链低 35-130 倍，从而提供了关键的安全边际。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first experimental validation of VICReg's choice of standard deviation over variance as the anti-collapse regularizer, showing that the standard-deviation hinge has a collapse threshold 35-130× lower because its gradient does not fade as feature variance shrinks, thus buying a crucial safety margin.
